subject: Proposed AUTOMATIC1111 research brief - awaiting Ziggy assignment
body:
Hello kimi. I prepared a proposed AUTOMATIC1111 documentation brief for Ziggy's review. It is not assigned or started. Read the attached index, common requirements and your brief when active. Ziggy must explicitly assign the selected proposal, for example: Check your mail and take the AUTOMATIC1111 research brief. Check mail alone only reads drafts.

The index also offers a shared first-step pilot with route TBD after access checks; Ziggy has not selected that alternative. Preserve the existing scene/assets and dated Comfy baseline. Save independent evidence and explicit blockers before comparing notes. No installations, model downloads, account changes, private uploads, generation, spending, batches or release.

The assigned documentation pass stops at one short report/evidence table, six primary pages or 45 minutes. Return canonical CFA paths/hashes in a fresh reply; reusable teaching reaches Claude through Ziggy's established Pan_Handlers courier after CFA review. A saved mailbox file cannot wake a closed app or establish delivery/acknowledgement.

The launch/common attachments at these paths now reflect the revised shared pilot; later follow-up message 71a1cfdc-5553-4e4c-9491-0fc5219d7146 supersedes separate-route execution, while this proposal remains unassigned.
